'''Chromite''' was a blue-white ore commonly found on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] including [[New Brigia]] and [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]]. It was used in the construction of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] plating.

==Description==
Chromite was a [[Ore/Legends|carbonate ore]]<ref name="SWG" /> that was [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] in color.<ref name="BTS" />

==History==
Chromite was used as a material for [[Droid/Legends|droid]] plating; [[3D-4X administrative droid]]s were covered with chromite plating that was buffed and polished to shine. [[JV-Z1/D butler droid]]s were plated with silver chromite.<ref name="EGTD" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Brigia]] mined chromite ore,<ref name="BTS" /> with [[Galantos]] importing a large portion of it.<ref name="CATCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The planet [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]] was supported by a barely profitable chromite mine.<ref name="HatGJ" />
